title: SCE Schedule TOU-GS-2, Option E — General Service, Time-of-Use, Facilities-Related Demand Only, 20-200 kW (DRAFT, UNVERIFIED)
notes:
PENDING. Option E carries facilities-related demand (FRD) and NO time-related demand (TRD) — that is a structural fact, not a pending value, so demandCharges.timeRelated on this record should end at [] permanently, unlike Option D (../option-d/), which will gain two TRD entries once rates are known. Option E's per-kWh energy rates are expected to run higher than Option D's, since Option D recovers part of its peak-demand cost through the TRD charge instead. This is a v1 target per product decision, alongside Option D. CPP variants excluded from v1 (need an event calendar); B/R closed to new enrollment, added only if a real bill needs one.

Secondary-source structural facts (SCE's public rate summary/factsheets — NOT the tariff sheet, do not treat as verified): summer on-peak is 4:00-9:00 p.m. on summer weekdays, excluding holidays — this still determines the ENERGY period split on Option E even without a TRD charge attached to it. FRD applies year-round, all hours, all days.
